showcase.user_prompt: 看一下看板，把待认领里能做的都做了。
showcase.assistant_reply: 我读了看板：3 条待认领，「正在处理」还剩 4 个名额。「登录页改版」被「统一设计令牌」挡着，我先做后者；另外两条无依赖，现在一起开工。做完一条我会提交到「待检查」等你验收。

blocks.title: 对话多了也不丢全局视角

items.title: 三条泳道一眼看清
items.description: 灵感池、正在处理、待检查。什么在打磨、什么在跑、什么等验收，不用再翻会话列表。

items.title: 看板即提问入口
items.description: 顶部敲一行回车就记下想法，点「派发」直接建会话开跑，全程不用进任何会话页。

items.title: Agent 自行认领派单
items.description: 标为「待认领」后 Agent 自己挑、自己决定并行还是排队；草稿它不碰。

items.title: 并发上限只管这块板
items.description: 默认同时最多 5 条在跑，够你跟得住；批量任务、自动化和手动会话都不受影响。

showcase.user_prompt: Check the board and take everything that's ready.
showcase.assistant_reply: Read the board: 3 ready, 4 slots left In Progress. "Login redesign" is blocked by "Unify design tokens", so I'll do that one first; the other two have no dependencies, starting both now. I'll submit each to Needs Review as it lands.

blocks.title: Keep the big picture as conversations pile up

items.title: Three lanes, one glance
items.description: Idea Pool, In Progress, Needs Review. What's being shaped, what's running, what's waiting on you.

items.title: The board is the prompt box
items.description: Type one line to capture an idea; hit Dispatch to spin up a session. You never leave the board.

items.title: The agent claims its own work
items.description: Mark a request Ready and the agent picks it up, deciding what to parallelize. Drafts it leaves alone.

items.title: A WIP limit scoped to this board
items.description: Five running at once by default — enough to actually keep up. Batch tasks and automations are untouched.
